words.meaning: The capacity to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness.
words.sentence1: Her resilience during the crisis inspired everyone around her.
words.sentence2: True resilience comes from facing challenges head-on with an open heart.

words.meaning: The quality of mind or spirit that enables a person to face difficulty, danger, or pain without fear; bravery.
words.sentence1: Su valentía en el escenario fue una verdadera inspiración para los jóvenes artistas. (Her bravery on stage was a true inspiration for the young artists.)
words.sentence2: Se necesita mucha valentía para decir la verdad en momentos difíciles. (It takes a lot of courage to tell the truth in difficult times.)

words.meaning: The ability to do something that frightens one; bravery.
words.sentence1: Il a eu le courage de poursuivre ses rêves malgré les obstacles. (He had the courage to pursue his dreams despite the obstacles.)
words.sentence2: Cette belle histoire m'a redonné le courage d'avancer. (This beautiful story gave me the courage to move forward again.)

words.meaning: Bravery or valor in the face of adversity.
words.sentence1: Seine Tapferkeit in dieser schweren Zeit diente allen als Inspiration. (His bravery during this difficult time served as an inspiration to everyone.)
words.sentence2: Wir bewundern die Tapferkeit der Freiwilligen. (We admire the courage of the volunteers.)

words.meaning: Hard struggle, strenuous effort, or fighting spirit.
words.sentence1: Kare no funtou wa watashitachi ni fukai yuuki o ataeta. (His strenuous effort gave us deep courage.)
words.sentence2: Sono funtou ga tsugi no kibo o umidashita. (That hard struggle created the next hope.)

words.meaning: Courage, bravery, or moral worth and excellence.
words.sentence1: Il suo alto valore morale è fonte di grande ispirazione. (His high moral courage is a source of great inspiration.)
words.sentence2: Ci vuole molto valore per difendere le proprie idee. (It takes a lot of courage to stand up for one's ideas.)

words.sentence1: Tā yǒnggǎn de xíngwéi gǔwǔ le zài chǎng de měi yí gè rén. (His courageous actions inspired everyone present.)
words.sentence2: Zuò yí gè yǒnggǎn de rén, qù zhuīqiú nǐ de mèngxiǎng. (Be a courageous person and pursue your dreams.)

words.sentence1: Geuui daedamham-eun modu-ege kkeunjinhan gamdong-eul ju-eotda. (His boldness gave everyone a deep touching inspiration.)
words.sentence2: Eoryeoun sanghwangeseo dojeonhaneun daedamham-i pillyohada. (Boldness to challenge oneself in a difficult situation is necessary.)

words.meaning: Energy, vigor, or heroic effort and inspiration.
words.sentence1: Komnot nis ban pleng visak sampeah jivit thmey. (This writing sparked the courage to greet a new life.)
words.sentence2: Tae trev kar visak pel jesprabang kapos. (One needs courage when facing obstacles.)

words.sentence1: Sy dapperheid in die aangesig van gevaar het ons almal geïnspireer. (His bravery in the face of danger inspired us all.)
words.sentence2: Met onbeskryflike dapperheid het hy sy doel bereik. (With indescribable courage he reached his goal.)
